---
description: "Use when modifying code in this workspace. Avoid automatic build, formatting, lint, or functional test runs after code edits unless explicitly requested."
applyTo: "**"
---
# Post-Edit Verification Preference
- After completing code modifications, do not automatically run build commands.
- Do not automatically run formatting checks or formatters.
- Do not automatically run lint checks.
- Do not automatically run functional tests.
- Only run build, format, lint, or test commands when the user explicitly asks for them.
